name: ce-gstack
description: Lean CE/gstack hybrid baseline for running the CE engineering loop without gstack runtime preamble state.

interface.shortDescription: Run the CE loop cleanly before deciding which gstack ideas earn their keep.
interface.longDescription: CE gstack is a Phase 1 hybrid baseline: Compound Engineering owns planning artifacts, requirements traceability, implementation workflow, review schema, repository knowledge, skill orchestration, and configuration. gstack contributes product judgment through docs only in this phase; its global runtime preamble and state probes are intentionally absent.
